The Trench&Bulkheads- T2W_PIPELINE.xlsm source was reissued 2026-08-17 with 37 PWG trench stop and bulkhead records that were not in the previous load. All 452 existing records are unchanged (differences are floating-point noise below 1e-11 and trailing spaces only). No records were removed from the source.
The reissued source writes "Bulk Head " with a trailing space on 46 bulkhead rows. Asset Type is stored trimmed in the Master Register; the Src sheet keeps the source text.

The takeoff states chainage in kilometres (0.06, 24.61) where every other register in this workbook uses metres. The takeoff's own SC(m)/EC(m) columns on the 70 PHW rows confirm the factor of 1000 (0.01 km -> 10 m). All 91 loaded records were multiplied by 1000. The Src - Tree Removal sheet keeps the kilometre values as stated.

The takeoff numbers PAE trees VEG_PAE001 to VEG_PAE003 twice, once at rows 15-17 (ch 0.06-0.51 km) and again at rows 228-230 (ch 7.13-7.25 km), so three IDs identify two assets each. PAE is not a section in this register so none of these rows were loaded; the collision must be resolved in the source before PAE can be brought in.
Sections not present in this register

The takeoff covers PAE (12), PLG (24), PLE (32) and PEL (63) in addition to PHW and PWG. This register covers PHW, PWG, PPH and RHF only, so those 131 rows were held back. They are on the Src - Tree Removal sheet in full and can be loaded once the sections are confirmed as in scope.

Five source cells hold values such as 235.00000000000003 and 1575.9999999999995, which store as 235 and 1576 when the Src sheet is written. The largest difference is 3.6e-12 m. The values are arithmetic noise in the source, not measurements.
Register totals cover all six sections

The summary block at the top of the takeoff totals 222 points and 44,867.94 m2 across six sections. The 91 records loaded here total 13,250.24 m2 (PHW 8,329.04 + PWG 4,921.20). The register will not reconcile to the takeoff total until the other four sections are loaded.
PWG-TB-026 to PWG-TB-134, PHW-TB-077 to PHW-TB-101

The Thrust Block Register was reissued 24-8 carrying 134 records that were not in the previous load: 109 PWG and 25 PHW. Every one has a chainage. All 121 previously loaded records are unchanged - a field-by-field comparison of all 38 shared columns found zero differences. No record was removed. Asset IDs continue the existing three-digit numbering and none collides.
New column in source: Thrust Block Category

The reissued register adds a Thrust Block Category column classifying each block as Bend (185), Tee (39), Isolation Valve (11), Pigging Station (5), In-Line (2) or Facility (RHF) (13). The column did not exist in the previous source, so it was added to the Master Register and populated for all 255 thrust blocks, including the 121 already held. Each backfilled value is logged individually on the Edit Log.

The 13 RHF records have carried no chainage since the baseline and were flagged as a gap. The new Thrust Block Category column classifies them as "Facility (RHF) - not in pipeline index", so they sit within the Regional Header Facility and are not positioned on the pipeline chainage. The blank is correct and is not missing data. They continue to sort to the end of the Master Register and remain outside the Chainage Index count.
Sheets 'Master Register - GIS rev E' and 'GIS - rev F'

Both GIS sheets in this workbook hold Jemena Port Kembla data (KGMS TO EGP, Eastern Gas Pipeline, drawing GAS-556-MA-AL-020) and carry no asset IDs. Neither is T2W data and neither has ever been loaded. Rows 294-312 of the LandPartners sheet, the colour legend and the eight Port Kembla survey rows, are hidden in this revision and remain excluded.

Trench stops rated at $1,112.50 each. Rate supplied by J. Krasnoff-Hnatjuk on 24 Aug 2026. The rate is per trench stop, not per metre of trench: it pairs with the bulkhead rate and matches the two details on C-DWG-PTW-105.1 Rev 1, Issued for Construction, which shows a sand/hessian bag trench stop and a reinforced concrete bulkhead as separate items.

Concrete bulkheads rated at $20,507.00 each. Rate supplied by J. Krasnoff-Hnatjuk on 24 Aug 2026. Detail on C-DWG-PTW-105.1 Rev 1, Issued for Construction: N32 concrete keyed into the trench walls and floor with N12 reinforcement, which is consistent with a rate an order of magnitude above a bagged trench stop.

Thrust blocks, trench sections, foreign services, creek crossings, road and rail crossings and vegetation carry no rate yet. Unit Rate, Quantity, Unit and Total Cost are deliberately blank on those rows rather than set to zero, so any total taken off this register is visibly incomplete rather than wrong.

Total Cost is =Unit Rate x Quantity on every rated row, so changing either input updates the total. Quantity is 1 on all rated rows because both rates are per item. If a rate later moves to a length or area basis, Quantity is where that goes.
